description: Change a post's video edit with 1 to 50 changes, in order: cut lines, trim, split, remove, move, add a take, swap a take, cut pauses, speed, freeze, volume, crop and rotate, punch-in, look, background, titles and images, captions, music, sound and fades, cover, size, transitions, J and L cuts, cutaways, layers, sounds on lanes, blurs and multicam angles. Ids and line numbers come from edit_get, as at base_rev for the whole batch. Cut by line (drop_lines, trim from_line/to_line, split after_line): code puts each cut in a pause so no word is clipped. Clip and caption ms are in the clip's take; titles, layers and the cover are on the finished video. A clip edge typed inside a word moves to the nearest pause. Product photos: image_add cut true (the phone cuts them out), canvas pattern, images_layout. A check's fix is a ready-made change. If one fails, none are saved. Pass base_rev; EDIT_CONFLICT means get the edit again and redo yours. The phone renders the result: ask with edit_render. Undo with undo.
